fulltext_layer.rights_boundary: Counts derive from manually coded research records; no full texts are released. Internal analysis permission, where present, is not a public redistribution licence.

semantic_hold_sensitivity.interpretation: Removing the current semantic holds does not change the leading recurrent places or the archive-level finding that recurrence is sparse.

bibliographic_layer.rights_boundary: Bibliographic signals are metadata_only and uncertain. They are not author-visit points and are never combined with full-text relation counts.
